Messages.Author: Jeroen
Messages.Body:
Hi,

I'm reworking an old OBF-Aus deck and I have a Q:

Is it possible to play a Hidden Lurker after a Change of Target?

eg: Religio bleeds and gets blocked. He plays Change of Target.
Can Watenda (with an Ivory Bow) play HL? The only requirement of HL
is that another minion you control is blocked and combat is over.

Jeroen

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jeroen wrote:
> Is it possible to play a Hidden Lurker after a Change of Target?

No. After CoT the is no action to modify (moreover, HL requires a
combat that, in the case of CoT, did not occur).
